title: Hearty Holiday Uruguayan Rapeseed Skewers
description: A festive Uruguayan dish featuring rapeseed oil and ferment-jang, served on a wooden board. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is perfect for the holidays.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together rapeseed oil, ferment-jang, and minced garlic.
Add sliced red onion, red bell pepper, and zucchini to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush the skewers with the remaining rapeseed oil mixture during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve the skewers on a wooden board, garnished with cherry tomatoes and chopped fresh parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
